cassia.predicted_cell_type: Glutamatergic excitatory neuron of the deep cortical layers (layer 6b / subplate-remnant neuron)
strengths: Directly supported by TBR1, DACH1, POU6F2, MEIS3 for glutamatergic cortical neuron identity
RXFP1, IL12RB2, OPRM1, THEMIS, SEMA3A, COL24A1, ADAMTS3, CDH6 specifically support layer 6b / subplate-remnant identity
Balanced reasoning distinguishes L6b from L6 CT and L5/6 pyramidal alternatives
weaknesses: Raw label is more specific than the available ontology term; mapping to CL:0000679 broadens the L6b/subplate identity to glutamatergic neuron
Subtype confidence relies partly on literature-based interpretation of marker combinations

strengths: Correctly captures the broad neuronal lineage supported by neuronal markers such as TBR1, NRG1, SEMA3A, CTNNA2
Avoids overcommitting to an unsupported subtype when using only the generic neuron call
weaknesses: Under-specific; ignores strong L6b/subplate markers RXFP1, IL12RB2, OPRM1, THEMIS
Rank2 L6 corticothalamic label (CL:4023042) lacks branch-specific support and is not favored over L6b by the original DEGs

strengths: Terms such as 'Protein-protein interactions at synapses' and 'Regulation of cortical dendrite branching' are consistent with a neuronal identity
weaknesses: Collagen/O-glycosylation and metabolism terms are not lineage-specific and cannot refine to a glutamatergic neuron subtype

supporting: TBR1, DACH1, POU6F2, MEIS3, NRG1 in the DEG list directly support glutamatergic cortical neuron identity
RXFP1, IL12RB2, OPRM1, THEMIS, SEMA3A, COL24A1, ADAMTS3, CDH6 support the layer 6b / subplate-remnant deep-layer glutamatergic subtype
PMID 23435839 and PMID 33328525 are consistent with the L6b/deep-layer excitatory neuron interpretation in cortical taxonomy
conflicting: In-house rank2 L6 corticothalamic label (CL:4023042) is not supported by branch-specific markers such as FOXP2/TLE4; observed RXFP1/IL12RB2/OPRM1 favor L6b over L6 CT
Enrichment terms alone are too general to distinguish glutamatergic neuron subtypes
enrichment_or_literature: Regulation of cortical dendrite branching and Protein-protein interactions at synapses are consistent with neuronal identity
Collagen biosynthesis/formation terms reflect ECM-associated L6b markers (COL24A1, ADAMTS3) and do not indicate stromal contamination

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
